About

More than marketing. I build ideas into results, and the teams that deliver them.

Currently a Business Development Executive at Pilgrim Professional, building the salon channel across South Delhi, after completing an MBA in Marketing & IT at Jamia Hamdard University. Over the last four years I've moved between corporate marketing floors, creative production and full-scale team leadership: Corporate and Retail Marketing internships at LG Electronics, two years leading digital communication for a school, and running two of Jamia Hamdard's largest student bodies as President of the Management Club and Vice President of the Social Media Club.

Leadership is the thread that ties it together. Planning the roadmap, training a team from nothing, holding a project together when ideas were stalling, and carrying it through to a result people could actually see. That's the part of marketing I care about most: not just making something look good, but making sure it gets built, shipped and repeated.

Case Studies

Five projects, start to finish

01

Building a school's digital presence from zero

Dar-Ul-Huda Public School · 2023 to 2026

Challenge

The school had no structured social media presence and no consistent way to reach parents or prospective students.

Approach

Took ownership of Instagram, Facebook and YouTube end to end: shooting, editing and publishing personally.

Execution

150+ posts, reels and videos; admissions campaigns pairing pamphlet drops with direct parent outreach.

Result

A functioning always-on channel that now carries admissions outreach, event visibility and parent communication.

02

Turning an inconsistent page into a publishing engine

Dept. of Management, JHU · Instagram

Challenge

No regular posting rhythm and no consistent creative benchmark, so content stayed ad hoc and easy to fall behind on.

Approach

Researched what strong academic-department content looks like, then designed a reusable template system anyone on the team could publish from.

Execution

Trained and consulted the wider Social Media Club team on the new workflow and pushed for a steady publishing cadence.

Result

A page that moved from irregular posting to an always-on rhythm: 1,000+ posts and reels published over his tenure.

03

Reuniting a stalled team to deliver TEDx

TEDx Jamia Hamdard · "The Paradox of Freedom"

Challenge

No one on the team had cracked TEDx's signature carousel format, and momentum was stalling: ideas for benchmark photos and videos kept getting dropped.

Approach

Stepped in personally to design the page's full visual system and carousel format from scratch.

Execution

Rebuilt the roadmap, brought the team back together, pitched the creative direction, and guided execution end to end.

Result

A cohesive, on-brand page (roughly 90 to 95% of its content designed personally) and a successfully delivered event.

04

Becoming a top individual contributor nationwide

LG Electronics · Radio Optimism · 2025

Challenge

Drive youth participation in LG's global AI-song microsite, in a short internship window, against interns across every LG India location.

Approach

Pushed the microsite across Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Telegram, Snapchat and YouTube, and built a screen-recorded tutorial to remove the biggest sign-up drop-off point.

Execution

Became one of LG's top individual contributors nationwide, converting 100+ verified participants from Jamia Hamdard alone.

Result

Meaningful lead growth for the microsite, a Certificate of Appreciation, and an invitation to LG's corporate office.

05

What actually moves Gen Z to buy fast fashion

MBA Dissertation · Jamia Hamdard · 2026

Challenge

Understand which social-media levers genuinely convert Gen Z shoppers, rather than which ones simply get attention.

Approach

A 30-question survey and a review of 225 secondary sources, distributed via QR cards on campus and across LinkedIn and WhatsApp.

Execution

Collected 333 responses and tested 7 hypotheses using the AIDA model, Theory of Planned Behaviour, Social Comparison Theory and Expectation-Confirmation Theory.

Result

Price promotions led conversion, UGC/reviews outperformed paid ads, and return-policy quality emerged as a key loyalty driver.
